title: The Town That Couldn't Stop Dancing
description:
In July 1518 a woman began dancing in a street in Strasbourg and did not stop. Within weeks between 50 and 400 people were dancing. Nobody knew why. Doctors reportedly told them to dance it out, and the city council gave them a hall and musicians, but it backfired, so the council banned dancing and music. The 'cure' was red shoes, holy water and a trip to a chapel. By September it was over. The cause is still unknown (theories include mass hysteria and ergot poisoning); how many people died is disputed, so we don't say.

Sources: Wikipedia, 'Dancing plague of 1518'. Historical sources are fragmentary; some details are 'claims'. The look of the characters is a joke, not how people looked.
